name: Brand Strategy Hub
description: Defines who your brand is and who it's for: brand profile (mission, value proposition, USPs), tracked competitors, target audience segments, SWOT analysis, and brand-vs-audience gap analysis with concrete recommendations to fill the gap. Hands a structured brand context downstream to Content Strategy Hub so the rest of the content pipeline is grounded in real positioning, not guesswork.

tools.name: create_brand_profile
tools.description: Create a new brand profile — mission, vision, value proposition, tone of voice, and unique selling points. The anchor for SWOT, competitor tracking, and target segments for this brand.

site_id.description: Optional link to a Content Strategy Hub site_id, e.g. 'g4s.md'
site_id.title: Site Id

mission.description: One or two sentences on why the brand exists
mission.title: Mission

vision.description: One or two sentences on where the brand wants to be
vision.title: Vision

value_proposition.description: The core promise made to customers
value_proposition.title: Value Proposition

tone_of_voice.description: How the brand sounds, e.g. 'confident, warm, no jargon'
tone_of_voice.title: Tone Of Voice

unique_selling_points.description: What makes this brand different, one point per item
unique_selling_points.title: Unique Selling Points

return_schema.description:
One brand under strategic analysis — the anchor every SWOT, segment,
and gap-analysis result links back to via brand_id.
return_schema.title: BrandProfile

tools.name: update_brand_profile
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing brand profile. Only given fields change.

brand_id.description: UUID of an existing brand profile — from list_brand_profiles, never invented
brand_id.title: Brand Id

brand_name.description: New brand name; omit to keep
brand_name.title: Brand Name

value_proposition.description: New value proposition; omit to keep
value_proposition.title: Value Proposition

tone_of_voice.description: New tone of voice; omit to keep
tone_of_voice.title: Tone Of Voice

return_schema.description:
One brand under strategic analysis — the anchor every SWOT, segment,
and gap-analysis result links back to via brand_id.
return_schema.title: BrandProfile

BrandProfile.description:

BrandProfile.title: BrandProfile

brand_id.description: UUID of an existing brand profile — from list_brand_profiles, never invented
brand_id.title: Brand Id

return_schema.description: One named competitor tracked against a brand.
return_schema.title: CompetitorProfile

tools.name: list_brand_competitors

CompetitorProfile.title: CompetitorProfile

tools.name: create_target_segment
tools.description: Define one target audience segment for a brand: demographics, psychographics, pain points, needs, preferred channels.

brand_id.description: UUID of an existing brand profile — from list_brand_profiles, never invented
brand_id.title: Brand Id

demographics.description: Age, role, company size, location, etc.
demographics.title: Demographics

needs.description: What this segment is looking for
needs.title: Needs

preferred_channels.description: Where this segment can be reached, e.g. 'LinkedIn', 'local search'
preferred_channels.title: Preferred Channels

return_schema.description: One audience segment a brand is trying to reach.

tools.name: list_target_segments

TargetSegment.description: One audience segment a brand is trying to reach.
TargetSegment.title: TargetSegment

tools.name: run_swot_analysis
tools.description: Run a SWOT analysis for a brand: strengths/weaknesses derived from its own profile, opportunities/threats derived from tracked competitors' weaknesses/strengths. Add competitors first via add_brand_competitor for a sharper result.

brand_id.description: UUID of an existing brand profile — from list_brand_profiles, never invented
brand_id.title: Brand Id

return_schema.description:
One SWOT analysis snapshot for a brand, derived from its profile and
tracked competitors. `body` (from sdl.Bodied) renders the full SWOT as
Markdown for quick human reading.

is_current marks the ONE live snapshot per brand -- running a new SWOT
automatically supersedes the previous current one (sets its is_current
to False and stamps superseded_at) rather than leaving two snapshots
both looking equally authoritative.
return_schema.title: SWOTResult

tools.name: list_swot_results
tools.description: List past SWOT analysis snapshots, optionally filtered by brand.

include_superseded.description: False (default) returns only the CURRENT snapshot per brand -- what a reader should actually act on. Set true to also see superseded (outdated) SWOT history.
include_superseded.title: Include Superseded

SWOTResult.description:
One SWOT analysis snapshot for a brand, derived from its profile and
tracked competitors. `body` (from sdl.Bodied) renders the full SWOT as
Markdown for quick human reading.

is_current marks the ONE live snapshot per brand -- running a new SWOT
automatically supersedes the previous current one (sets its is_current
to False and stamps superseded_at) rather than leaving two snapshots
both looking equally authoritative.
SWOTResult.title: SWOTResult

tools.name: run_gap_analysis
tools.description: Run a gap analysis between a brand's current positioning and one target segment's needs/pain points -- what the segment needs that the brand doesn't yet address, plus concrete recommendations to fill the gap.

brand_id.description: UUID of an existing brand profile — from list_brand_profiles, never invented
brand_id.title: Brand Id

segment_id.description: UUID of an existing target segment — from list_target_segments, never invented
segment_id.title: Segment Id

return_schema.description:
One brand-vs-audience gap analysis: what a target segment needs that
the brand's current positioning does not yet address, plus concrete
'fill the gap' recommendations.

is_current marks the ONE live analysis per (brand_id, segment_id) pair --
re-running for the same segment supersedes the previous current result
instead of leaving two, so a reader never has to guess which is fresh.
return_schema.title: GapAnalysisResult

tools.name: list_gap_analyses
tools.description: List past brand-vs-audience gap analysis results, optionally filtered by brand.

include_superseded.description: False (default) returns only the CURRENT result per (brand, segment) pair. Set true to also see superseded (outdated) gap-analysis history.
include_superseded.title: Include Superseded

GapAnalysisResult.description:
One brand-vs-audience gap analysis: what a target segment needs that
the brand's current positioning does not yet address, plus concrete
'fill the gap' recommendations.

is_current marks the ONE live analysis per (brand_id, segment_id) pair --
re-running for the same segment supersedes the previous current result
instead of leaving two, so a reader never has to guess which is fresh.
GapAnalysisResult.title: GapAnalysisResult

tools.name: delete_target_segment

tools.name: delete_brand_profile
tools.description: Permanently delete a brand profile AND cascade-delete everything anchored to it: its tracked competitors, target segments, SWOT snapshots (current + superseded), and gap analyses. Requires confirm_cascade=true. Irreversible.

brand_id.description: UUID of an existing brand profile — from list_brand_profiles, never invented
brand_id.title: Brand Id

confirm_cascade.description: Must be explicitly true. Deleting a brand profile cascades to ALL of its competitors, target segments, SWOT snapshots, and gap analyses — irreversible.
confirm_cascade.title: Confirm Cascade

tools.name: archive_swot_result

swot_id.description: UUID of an existing SWOT snapshot — from list_swot_results, never invented

gap_analysis_id.description: UUID of an existing gap analysis — from list_gap_analyses, never invented
gap_analysis_id.title: Gap Analysis Id

return_schema.description:
One brand-vs-audience gap analysis: what a target segment needs that
the brand's current positioning does not yet address, plus concrete
'fill the gap' recommendations.

is_current marks the ONE live analysis per (brand_id, segment_id) pair --

tools.name: purge_brand_strategy_data
tools.description: Wipe ALL brand strategy WORKING data derived from a brand -- tracked competitors, target segments, SWOT snapshots (current + superseded), and gap analyses. Brand profiles themselves are NEVER touched, mirroring Content Strategy Hub's purge_pipeline_data (which keeps site profiles): a brand profile is the anchor record, equivalent to a connected site, not disposable pipeline output. Requires confirm_wipe=true.

confirm_wipe.description: Must be explicitly true to run the purge. Safety flag so this can never fire by accident from a misread instruction.
confirm_wipe.title: Confirm Wipe

return_schema.description:
Outcome of a full brand-strategy data wipe — counts removed per
collection. Brand profiles themselves are never touched by this.
return_schema.title: PurgeResult

tools.name: build_content_strategy_handoff
tools.description: Reshape a brand profile into the exact fields Content Strategy Hub's create_site_profile expects, so the rest of the pipeline (Content Strategy Hub -> Article Writer -> Media Studio Hub -> WordPress Hub) starts from real brand positioning. There is no cross-extension IPC on this platform -- Webbee relays this payload into Content Strategy Hub's own create_site_profile in the same chat turn.

brand_id.description: UUID of an existing brand profile — from list_brand_profiles, never invented
brand_id.title: Brand Id

site_id.description: Site id to use downstream, e.g. 'g4s.md' — matches Content Strategy Hub's site_id
site_id.title: Site Id

domain.description: Domain for the site; defaults to site_id if omitted
domain.title: Domain

return_schema.description:
Reshapes a brand profile into the exact fields Content Strategy Hub's
create_site_profile/update expects, so brand strategy work does not have
to be manually re-typed into the content-planning layer downstream.
There is no direct extension-to-extension call on this platform — Webbee
relays this payload into Content Strategy Hub's own tool in the same
chat turn.
return_schema.title: BrandContentHandoff

tools.name: list_connected_sites
tools.description: List the sites already connected in other apps (WordPress Hub today, any future site provider) that Quick Add offers as one-click brand candidates, flagging which ones already have a brand profile here. Also the diagnostic for an empty Quick Add list: it reports whether a provider could not be reached and why.

ConnectedSite.description:
One site read from a site-provider extension (WordPress Hub today,
more providers later) — the raw material behind the Quick Add list.
ConnectedSite.title: ConnectedSite
